Silverwing Squadron/attack-creates-one-k: The Knight token IS created (count 1, asserted and passing) and its creation counts toward the Squadron's CDA (Squadron 2/2, correct), but the tapped-and-attacking Knight deals NO combat damage: p1 took 2 damage (18 life), not 3 -- the token never joined the attackers (CR 506.4, 510.1). Contrast: Adeline's attacking Human token DOES attack and deal damage in this family, so the mechanism exists and Silverwing's token registration path is the odd one out.
Silverwing Squadron/vigilance-attacker-u: The CDA reading is CORRECT: with the created Knight token the Squadron counts 4 creatures you control and reads 4/4 (CR 604.3) -- the round-1 defect row that claimed 'the Knight does not count toward the CDA here' was withdrawn after re-counting (its 5/5 want needed 5 creatures that do not exist). The only real divergence is the one the lone-Squadron scenario already records: the tapped-and-attacking Knight deals no combat damage, so p1 took 4 (16 life) instead of 6 (14 life).
Etali, Primal Storm/casts-both-exiled-sp: 'You may cast any number of spells from among those cards' (CR 608.2g): with Lightning Bolt exiled from its controller's library and Divination from the opponent's, both are cast for free. Observed: both are offered in one multi-pick ask and both picks are accepted, but only the first is cast (the Bolt hits for 3; Divination stays in exile, hand 0, and no second ask follows). The controls pass: either card alone is cast, including a sorcery in combat and a card from the opponent's library. New root, found by the FDN audit batch 5; no ticket yet.
Etali, Primal Storm/casts-two-exiled-ins: Expected both exiled instants (Lightning Bolt and Shock) to be cast for free, opponent at 15. Observed: only the Bolt is cast (17) and Shock stays in exile. Same root as casts-both-exiled-spells-free; answering with two separate single picks changes nothing (no second ask is posed).

Drakuseth, Maw of Flames/attack-four-to-: CR 603.3d/115.1d: all of the attack trigger's targets (4 damage to the opponent, 3 to each of up to two other targets) are chosen as it is put on the stack. Observed: only the 4-damage target is asked when the trigger goes on the stack; the 3-damage targets are posed as a resolution-time choose, so the two creatures named with the trigger (Hill Giant, Grizzly Bears) are untouched (opponent 16, both creatures alive). A control answering that resolution-time choose with the two creatures kills both, so only the timing is wrong. Known root: same as Bite Down/second-target-is-chosen-on-cast (later targets asked at resolution, not on cast/trigger).
Drakuseth, Maw of Flames/three-damage-to: CR 603.3d: the opponent named as a 3-damage target when the trigger is put on the stack takes 3 (life 17) and the 4-damage creature dies. Known root: Bite Down/second-target-is-chosen-on-cast.
Drakuseth, Maw of Flames/one-illegal-tar: CR 608.2b: when one of three targets (Grizzly Bears) is bounced in response, the trigger still deals 4 to the opponent and 3 to the remaining legal target (Hill Giant dies).
